DFCC Bank quarter profit up 23% 🏦📈

DFCC Bank PLC (DFCC) made a profit of Rs 3.38 billion for shareholders in the July to September 2026 quarter. That is 23% more than a year ago, and 48% more than the last quarter.

Net interest income grew 11% to Rs 8.66 billion. Loan impairment charges fell 80% to Rs 177 million. For the first nine months, profit was Rs 7.43 billion, 13% lower than last year.

Source: DFCC interim financial statements, Colombo Stock Exchange, https://cdn.cse.lk/cmt/upload_report_file/371_1794560982951.pdf
